title: OTA plans
description: roll out firmware updates to your device fleet

info.title: What is an OTA Plan?
info.description: An OTA plan rolls out a firmware update to a set of devices as a template-to-template migration: each device downloads the binary, applies it, and only then switches to the target template.

migration.title: Template Migration
migration.text: Devices move from the source template to the target template only after reporting a successful update

paced.title: Paced & Safe
paced.text: Dispatch is presence-gated and paced, with automatic abort when the failure rate crosses the configured threshold

window.title: Bounded Window
window.text: Every plan runs between a start time and a deadline; pending devices time out when the window closes

empty.title: no OTA plans yet
empty.description: create your first plan to roll out a firmware update

cancelDialog.title: cancel OTA plan
cancelDialog.message: this stops the rollout: pending devices will not be updated and the firmware binary will be purged. This cannot be undone.

messages.loadError: failed to load the plan details
